speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you've brought your husband here concerned about his bizarre and agitated behavior. To better understand the situation, can you tell me specifically what these behaviors look like and how long they have been occurring?

Additionally, have there been any recent changes in his medication or substance use?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the fixed delusion about the NSA and mind control, along with his withdrawal and functional decline over three months, have you noticed any significant changes in his sleep pattern or appetite recently?

Also, does he report any hallucinations, such as hearing voices, or any history of similar episodes in the past?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP, TSH, Urine_Tox_Screen, RPR.

text: creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant medical or psychiatric history reported. Social history: Previously employed. No history of substance abuse reported. Married.

speaker: Patient
text: No significant findings. Denies any drug use, recent travel, or physical health issues. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia (First Episode)

The mention of "Tuberculosis" by a previous doctor seems unrelated to his core symptoms of persecutory delusions (NSA mind control), functional decline, and social withdrawal which strongly point toward a primary psychotic disorder. Do you recall if he ever reported hearing voices or seeing things that others do not? REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray (just to definitively rule out the TB concern raised by the patient).
